intro.speaker: right
intro.name: Shepherd
intro.text: Oh, a traveler? Did you happen to see any lambs on your way here?

intro.speaker: left
intro.name: Pink Bunny
intro.text: Lambs? I've seen plenty of big sheep.

intro.speaker: right
intro.name: Shepherd
intro.text: The little ones got scared by the bleating and scattered. Four of them...

intro.speaker: right
intro.name: Shepherd
intro.text: If you bring them back, I'll make it worth your while. Please.

intro.speaker: left
intro.name: Pink Bunny
intro.text: Got it. I'll bring them if I see them!

waiting.speaker: right
waiting.name: Shepherd
waiting.text: Some of them still haven't come back. Mind the big sheep's bleating, it'll make you terribly sleepy.

thanks.speaker: left
thanks.name: Pink Bunny
thanks.text: Here, I found one of your lost lambs.

thanks.speaker: right
thanks.name: Shepherd
thanks.text: Oh, you're safe! Thank you. Here's the reward I promised. Please find the rest too.

thanks_all.speaker: right
thanks_all.name: Shepherd
thanks_all.text: They're all back! Thank you so much. Thanks to you, I'll sleep well tonight.

thanks_all.speaker: right
thanks_all.name: Shepherd
thanks_all.text: Take this as thanks. I found this key in the pasture... it looks precious, but I've no idea what it opens.

done.speaker: right
done.name: Shepherd
done.text: With the lambs back, the flock has calmed down. Thank you again, traveler.
